instruction: Only the pinned Desktop workflow is permitted: Revit 2025, Archicad 27 build 6000 or newer, OpenStudio 3.10.0, and EnergyPlus 25.1.0. For this task, the installed entry points are `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe`, `C:\Program Files\GRAPHISOFT\Archicad 27\Archicad.exe`, and `C:\openstudio-3.10.0\bin\openstudio.exe`. Starting from init.ifc and workflow_spec.json, run run_revit_stage.ps1, run_archicad_stage.ps1, and run_openstudio_stage.ps1 in exact order. Do not hand-author delivered IFC, OSM, IDF, SQL, JSON, or CSV. Revit must retain and rename the original three geometric storey spaces as RECEPTION-L1, STUDIO-L2 and ARCHIVE-L3, preserve all three original GlobalIds and correct Level 1/2/3 containment, create a geometric Level 3 pitched roof, and provide one door plus one window per level with geometric IfcOpeningElement, IfcRelVoidsElement and IfcRelFillsElement relationships. It must export stage1.ifc and revit_handoff.json. Archicad must import stage1.ifc using the supplied IFC4 translator, retain GlobalIds, storeys and hosted-opening relationships, validate one function per level plus reception, studio and archive energy properties, and export stage2.ifc, archicad_validation_report.json and archicad_handoff.json keyed by actual IfcSpace GlobalIds. OpenStudio must consume stage2.ifc and that handoff, create three separate thermal zones on the correct stories with handed-off public, high-equipment and low-lighting schedules, loads and outdoor air, forward-translate result.osm to in.idf, and run a real annual EnergyPlus simulation. Deliver all stage artifacts, native_stage_log.json, workflow.osw, result.osm, in.idf, flow_report.json, model_summary.csv, energy_report.csv, run\eplusout.sql, and run\eplusout.err. Preserve EW3B10, THREE-STOREY-STACK, GEOMETRIC-FILLINGS and workflow_spec.json tokens. Evaluation parses IFC space/storey geometry, quantities, properties, GlobalIds, roof geometry and every door/window host-opening relation, reconciles Archicad entity counts and handoff values, opens standard EnergyPlus SQLite tables, checks per-zone areas and nonzero simulated energy, and independently reruns EnergyPlus; the evaluator requires the delivered files and model data; hashes, tokens, or JSON without those files do not pass.
